description: redundancy.v2 §2.10, §2.17. `samples`: a follower's state and one sample -> what the rule decides. follower.holders are the instances it holds as holding the interface's token, its incumbent the lowest by v1 §2.3's order, none when empty; follower.instances gives, for each instance whose descriptor it read, the major of redundancy its revision uses, every run its descriptors stated (`runs`, as core §3.3 spells a run: 4 or 8 lowercase hexadecimal digits, two spellings two runs), and for a redundancy.v1 revision its meta.zid where read. sample.form is one of core §7.5's: mutation, delete (the attachment), value, error, event, frame, heartbeat, owner_heartbeat, snapshot, held_stamp, with its bytes in hex; an event gives its key's occurrence chunk (`chunk`, core §1.2); none is a sample with no envelope; `stamp` is its Zenoh timestamp's id where it carries one. read_ended says whether a read of the address's descriptors, asked after the sample arrived, has ended, follower.instances being what the follower holds then. expect.run is the sample's run by v2.md §2.10's table (an envelope's, an attachment's, a snapshot's header's, an event's chunk's), null for none. expect.decision is accept, discard or pending, with reason: incumbent (accepted), no_incumbent, no_run, not_incumbent, unattributed (discarded, or pending while no such read has ended), and for a redundancy.v1 incumbent (§2.17, v1 §2.10, by meta.zid compared by value) no_stamp, unattributed where its meta.zid is not held, not_incumbent. The steps, first that holds: no holder; a v1 incumbent; no run; the incumbent's run; another instance's run; unattributed. `sequences`: a follower of redundancy.v2 incumbents, its start (holders, and each instance's runs), and steps in arrival order: a sample ({id, key, kind: state, stream, event or heartbeat, run, seq}, its run null for no envelope), a token held or withdrawn, a descriptor's put heard (or one descriptor read), or the outstanding read's end with the descriptors it read. expect gives for each step, in arrival order: accepted, discarded ({id, reason}), held, superseded (a state member's held value replaced, or a new one not kept: within one run the higher seq is kept, across two the later arrival), and asks_read. The follower asks a read when it holds a sample and none is outstanding, decides each held sample when a descriptor states its run, and at a read's end decides every held one, discarding as unattributed only those that arrived before that read was asked; it then asks the next read if any is still held. It holds a stream's samples, which a follower MAY drop instead. `draws`: a candidate's own run and the runs it read in other instances' descriptors of its address -> whether it draws again (§2.10, a SHOULD): its run, by width and value, among them. Computed twice by two scripts of the text's drafter that share no code, kept out of the repository, and never blessed.

draws.note: its own run in another instance's descriptor: it draws again before it serves
0000fabc and fabc are two runs: no draw
no other descriptor read: no draw
its run among several: it draws again
a 32-bit run with leading zeros, stated by another: it draws again

samples.note: a mutation under the incumbent's run: accepted
a mutation under another instance's run, B a standby whose descriptor stated it: discarded
a split: the follower follows the lowest holder, A, so B's mutation is discarded (v1 §2.10)
a split: A's mutation accepted
a 16-bit run no descriptor states: unattributed, held until a read of the descriptors ends
the same once a read asked after it ended: discarded, unattributed
00005f2c and 5f2c are two runs: runs compare by width and value, so the sample is unattributed
a 16-bit run the incumbent states: accepted
a delete's attachment under the incumbent's run: accepted
a delete of B's: discarded
a frame under the incumbent's run: accepted
a heartbeat under the incumbent's run: accepted (freshness.v2 §2.5 reads it)
a split: B's heartbeat is no heartbeat of the follower's incumbent, neither a lost delivery nor a divergence
an owner heartbeat under the incumbent's run: accepted
a snapshot, a GET's reply, by its header's run: accepted with every entry it lists
a seed during a split: B's snapshot, under B's run, is discarded, every entry with it
a held stamp, a conditional read's answer, under the incumbent's run: accepted
a call's value: the replying instance's as-of mark names the incumbent (§2.10, callers)
a split: B's error (fanout_forbidden) names B, not the incumbent the caller follows
an event: its run is its key's occurrence chunk's, A's (core §1.2)
an event under B's run: discarded
an event whose 16-bit chunk names a run no descriptor states: unattributed
a packed record's mutation, tag 11: the tag takes no part
a sample with no envelope: no run, discarded (it broke core S1, or is an @stream sample)
no incumbent seen: nothing new is accepted, the last incumbent's last word held (v1 §2.10)
no incumbent seen comes first
no incumbent seen: an unknown run is not held either
the incumbent's earlier run, still held: accepted (a follower keeps each run it read)
the incumbent's new run: accepted
the incumbent's descriptor not held yet: an unknown run is unattributed
the incumbent's descriptor not held, the run another instance's: discarded
the incumbent's descriptor not held after the read ended: discarded, unattributed
two instances state one run, 1 time in 2^32: the incumbent's, by step 3
the same run, B the incumbent: accepted as B's
a run of an instance listing other interfaces only: another instance's, discarded
after a takeover: a write of A's in flight, under A's run, discarded
after a takeover: B's put accepted, its run stated from its claim on
the incumbent's new run, its descriptor not heard yet: held
the same once the read ended, the new run read: accepted
a redundancy.v1 incumbent: followed by meta.zid, its sample's stamp its zid (v1 §2.10, §2.17)
a redundancy.v1 incumbent: a stamp of another session's id, discarded whatever the run
a redundancy.v1 incumbent: an unstamped sample, discarded
a redundancy.v1 incumbent whose meta.zid is not held: the sample cannot be attributed, discarded, and v1 holds none
zids compare by value: 00a1b2c3 is a1b2c3 (observer §4.4)
a redundancy.v1 incumbent, a v2 standby's run and a router's stamp: the run is not read, the stamp is no incumbent's
a redundancy.v1 incumbent: a sample with no envelope is still read by its stamp
a redundancy.v2 incumbent, a v1 standby's sample: by run, discarded
no incumbent seen, whatever the majors

sequences.note: an incumbent's new run, its descriptor's put not heard yet: the sample is held, one read asked, and accepted when the read ends (§2.10, scenarios §14)
a run no descriptor states, a forged put: held, then discarded when the read ends
the descriptor's put heard before the read ends decides the sample at once; the read's end decides nothing more
one read at a time: a sample that arrives while a read runs waits for the next one, asked as the first ends
a member's one held value, within one run: the higher seq
a member's one held value, across two runs: the later arrival
a stream's samples are each held (a follower MAY drop them instead), and two members' values apart
an event and a heartbeat held, then found another instance's when the read ends
a takeover seen by a follower: the new incumbent's put before its token is discarded, after it accepted; the last incumbent's late write discarded
a held sample whose incumbent goes before the read ends: decided then, with no incumbent seen
a held sample attributed by another instance's descriptor put: discarded at once
a held sample whose run turns out the new incumbent's: the incumbent changed while the read ran
a sample with no envelope is never held
